tool: Cursor Agent — PITR vs daily snapshot
promptText: Architecture dinged RPO as ~24h daily snapshot while RDS backup_retention=7 already enables PITR. Challenge the restore script: should AZ-failure DR call restore-db-instance-to-point-in-time --use-latest-restorable-time first, and when is snapshot fallback required? Do not rewrite the runbook.
responseText: PITR is the cheaper better RPO (~5 min latest restorable). Call it first. Snapshot fallback only if the source instance cannot PITR (API error / AZ isolation). Keep backup_retention=7. Do not claim 24h RPO as the primary contract.

promptText: Architecture: Spot/on-demand floor is weaker under sustained interruption than the runbook implied. What does FARGATE base=1 actually guarantee after us-east-1a dies?
responseText: base=1 is a capacity-provider placement preference for extra tasks, not regional spare capacity. If 1b has no on-demand Fargate, the service stays at 0 healthy tasks until capacity returns. Document that; do not call it an SLA.
